title: Save Your Money
text: If I could give negative stars I would. I should have read the reviews before I ordered. Cheap products, the sweatshirt was cheap and felt like felt not like an actual sweatshirt. Nothing worth keeping in the box. I canceled the subscription after I ordered it and read the review.  I received it and was extremely disappointed. Do not give this to an SPN Fan unless you actually hate them.
label: negative
